integrity: The proof refines the published Boolean-center decomposition and product formula. An exhaustive labelled-poset replay through five points independently checks the second-gap and equality structure on finite test instances.
limitations: Finite Heyting algebras and excluded middle only; attainable degrees below 1/2 are not classified. An equivalent second-gap observation may exist as uncatalogued folklore.
title: The second excluded-middle gap in finite Heyting algebras
